name: Daily Hydration Kit
subtitle: For: Mild to Moderate Dryness
usageInstructions: After bathing, take take a generous amount of lotion on your palm and gently massage it over the body until absorbed. Roll on the product on to dry feet, wait until absorbed.
description: Give your skin everyday nourishment with the Daily Hydration Kit — a dermatologist-designed duo that gently cleanses, replenishes moisture, and supports a healthy skin barrier. ✨ Why It Works This routine pairs lipid-rich Triple Milk Extracts with 10% Urea, a key component of the skin’s Natural Moisturizing Factor (NMF). Together, they hydrate, soften flaky skin, and maintain a balanced barrier. ✨ What’s Inside ✅ Triple Milk Deep Hydrating Body Wash – A gentle cleanser that cleanses without stripping and restores essential moisture. ✅10% Urea Lotion – A dermatologist-approved hydrating lotion with 10% Urea + nourishing butters - all in a lightweight, non-greasy texture. 💫 The Result Consistent, lasting hydration your skin can rely on!
usage: Step 1: Apply a generous amount of body wash to your palms or loofah. Massage onto wet skin in a circular motion. Step 2: Rinse thoroughly after cleansing. Step 3: Take a generous amount of lotion and massage onto your hands and feet, until absorbed. Step 4: Massage an even layer all over the body until completely absorbed.

list.title: How to Use Daily Hydration Kit
list.content:
To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use the lotion regularly and consistently for 3-4 months.

Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

Step 1
Apply a generous amount of body wash to your palms or loofah. Massage onto wet skin in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly after cleansing.
Step 2
Take a generous amount of lotion and massage onto your hands and feet, until absorbed. Massage an even layer all over the body until completely absorbed.

list.title: Can I use this Kit every day?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using the bodywash and lotion kit for all skin types twice a day, every day.

list.title: Is this kit for all skin types?
list.content: Yes - this lotion and bodywash can be used by all skin types, especially dry skin types

list.title: Can I use this twice a day?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using it twice a day.

list.title: I have damaged skin, will it help me?
list.content: This kit contains Urea lotion which is safe for sensitive skin. However, it is recommended to conduct a patch test and consult a dermatologist before use.

list.title: Can I use it right after a bath?
list.content: Yes, you can use it any time of the day.
